mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.order_id, o.order_no, i.product_id, i.product_name, i.address, i.contact_name, i.contact_phone, i.expected_time, i.confirmed_time, i.engineer_name, i.engineer_phone, i.user_remark, i.admin_remark, i.status, i.create_time FROM tb_installation i LEFT JOIN tb_order o ON i.order_id = o.id WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY i.create_time DESC
